title: Launches tracked by WB-57, F-104 and NRO satellites

tellings.quote: at that point it's intercepted by a WB-57 run out of Houston by a good friend of mine which is National Reconnaissance Office works with Taylor.

plain: Launches from Cape Canaveral are said to be followed by a WB-57, a high-flying research plane flown out of Houston, along with F-104 jets and the satellites of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US spy-satellite agency. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, tells Michels this second-hand: the WB-57 is run, he says, by a good friend of his who works with a man named Timothy Taylor.
